questions.question: When is Harbor Community Lab open on Saturdays?
questions.reference: The lab opens on Saturdays from 10:00 to 16:00.

questions.question: How much does student membership cost and what is required?
questions.reference: Student membership costs 10 credits per month and requires a valid student ID.

questions.question: How many items can a member borrow, and for how long?
questions.reference: Members can borrow up to two items at a time for seven calendar days.

questions.question: What is the late return fee and its maximum per item?
questions.reference: Late returns cost 2 credits per item per day, capped at 20 credits per item.

questions.question: What happens after two missed workshops without timely cancellation?
questions.reference: Workshop booking privileges are suspended for 30 days.

questions.question: What training is required before using the laser cutter?
questions.reference: Members must complete a 90-minute safety induction and pass a practical check with a supervisor.

questions.question: How many free printing pages do members get, and do unused pages roll over?
questions.reference: Members get 20 free black-and-white pages each calendar month; unused pages do not roll over.

questions.question: When is a meeting room released if the organizer is late?
questions.reference: The room is released if the organizer has not arrived within 15 minutes of the reservation start.

questions.question: How long are equipment loan records retained after return?
questions.reference: Equipment loan records are retained for 12 months after the item is returned.

questions.question: What is the maximum project grant and when must a completion report be submitted?
questions.reference: The maximum grant is 200 credits, and a completion report is due within 60 days of receiving the grant.
